Oṃ vajra-tīkṣṇa-duḥkhaccheda-prajñājñāna-mūla.
Mind and mental factors (citta-caitta).
OṂ VAJRA-CITTA (OṂ VAJRA-MIND). OṂ VAJRA-ĀSANA (OṂ VAJRA-SEAT).
OṂ VAJRA-BHŪMI-BANDHA HŪṂ VAṂ RAṂ LAṂ (OṂ VAJRA-GROUND-BOUNDARY HŪṂ VAṂ RAṂ LAṂ).
OṂ VAJRA-BHŪMI BANDHA BANDHA SVĀHĀ. Seal the boundaries of the ten directions.
OṂ VAJRA-KĪLAYA KĪLAYA SARVA-VIGHNĀN BANDHA HŪṂ PHAṬ. Shatter the Vighnas.
Uṣṇīṣa. Adhiṣṭhāna-vastra.
Rinse and wash the mouth. Bathe.
Dharmapāla. Devasūtra.
OṂ VAJRĀNUPRABHĀVA SVĀHĀ. Offer flowers. OṂ VAJRAKUSUMA SVĀHĀ. Offer incense. OṂ VAJRAGANDHA SVĀHĀ. Offer unguents.
Burn incense: OṂ VAJRA DHŪPA HŪṂ SVĀHĀ. Light lamps: OṂ VAJRA ĀLOKE SVĀHĀ.
Naivedya. Arghya.
OṂ VAJRA-ĀHĀRA ĀHARA SVĀHĀ. Offerings such as food and so forth.
OṂ VAJRĀKṢAYA JÑĀNAKARMAṆE SVĀHĀ. Consecrate the rosary.
For the recitation, first recite this mantra: OṂ VAJRA-SATTVA HŪṂ SVĀHĀ.
Then, bind the cross-legged posture (paryaṅka) with: OṂ VAJRASATTVA SAMAYAM ANUPĀLAYA VAJRASATTVA TVEṂ ĀḤ HŪṂ.
KHAṂ VAṂ BHAṂ RAṂ SAṂ JĀLAYA SARVATATHĀGATĀN. KHAṂ VAṂ BHAṂ RAṂ SAṂ ĀHŪYAYA SARVATATHĀGATĀN.
Oṃ vajra-ratna-saṃbhava-jñāna-vajra-samaya-mahā-ratna-krodha-hūṃ jjaḥ svāhā.
Requesting the vows. Oṃ vajra-dharma-saṃbhava-bodhisattva-samaya-mahā-dharma-krodha-hūṃ jjaḥ svāhā. Requesting the vows of the Bodhisattvas.
Oṃ sarvadevanāgān āhvayāmi. Oṃ caturmahārājādīn āhvayāmi.
[Please all devas and nāgas. Please the Four Great Kings and others.]
OṂ VAJRA-GUHYA-ĀVEŚAYA ĀḤ HŪṂ: Consecrate the disciple.
OṂ VAJRĀVEŚAYA ĀḤ HŪṂ: Cause the disciple to enter the maṇḍala.
OṂ VAJRA-MAHĀKALA-HŪṂ PHAṬ. I offer this food to all Buddhas, all Bodhisattvas, and the various devas.
HAṂ VAJRA-DHĀRAṆI-SVĀHĀ. Dispatch all the assembly of noble ones. OṂ VAJRĀMṚTA-KUṆḌALI HŪṂ PHAṬ. SVĀHĀ. Offer the substances and protect the body.
Oṃ vajrābhiṣeka hūṃ. Perform the empowerment for the disciple. Oṃ vajra-dhātu-svabhāva-ātmako ’ham. Perform the Dharma-offering homa.
I now prostrate to all of them. This is the Heart Mantra of the Tathāgata Universal Radiance (Samantaprabhā): Oṃ namo bhagavate samantaprabhāya tathāgatāya.
The Heart-Seal of All Tathāgatas: Oṃ Vajra-tathāgata-samaya-jñāna-vajriṇe hūṃ.
The Universal Great Jewel Samaya of All Tathāgatas: Oṃ Vajra-tathāgata-mahāratna-samaya-hūṃ.
Sarvatathāgata-vyūha-mahāratna-prabha. Vajra-siṃhāsana.
The Empowerment of the Emergence of the Great Jewel.
The Spiritual Support of the Miraculous Power of the Blazing Wheel-Dharma that Subdues Māras.
Ajita-jaya. Sarva-tathāgata-dharma-cakra-pravartaka.
Vajrapāṇi.
Ratnavajra Bodhisattva. The Four Great Heavenly Kings.
Śrī-devī; Cundā-devī.
The messenger goddesses: OṂ VAJRA-DĀKINI HŪṂ PHAṬ.
All the holy assemblies within the maṇḍala: OṂ SARVA-TATHĀGATA-MAHĀKĀRUṆIKA-SIDDHI-HŪṂ PHAṬ SVĀHĀ.
Puṣpadantī Devī. Written in the Imperial script (Gyōsho).
The original text states that it was transcribed using the Imperial script of the *Mūla-tantra*, which is called "Vajra" (Kongō) and "Radiant Manifestation" (Ken'yō).
